group_rule: Canonical bidirectional five-tuple; exclude any group in ANY frozen A/B split, then every group spanning C splits; whole flow must fit inside assigned time block
selection_rule: Chronological capture roles/time windows inherited from pretraining protocol; no current model metrics used
limitations: Selected short pieces of one continuous recording day, not independent capture sessions.
Boundary flows may be truncated by PCAP sharding; completed EVE flows are not early attack detection.
Pilot selected for verified LDAP and benign coverage; background/class imbalance may bias results.
Only explicitly timestamp/5tuple-matched BENIGN and DrDoS_LDAP are eligible; unknown excluded.
A/B frozen splits remain unchanged; one seed only; no FL or generalization claim.
scope: Laptop C local-only pilot, before current model fitting
